194	// handleAnalyze processes error inquiries from CORTEX
195	func (hs *HEARTService) handleAnalyze(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
196		if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
197			http.Error(w, "Method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
198			return
199		}
200	
201		// Enable CORS for WASM clients
202		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
203		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "POST, OPTIONS")
204		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
205		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
206	
207		if r.Method == http.MethodOptions {
208			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
209			return
210		}
211	
212		startTime := time.Now()
213	
214		// Parse inquiry
215		var inquiry HEARTErrorInquiry
216		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&inquiry); err != nil {
217			http.Error(w, fmt.Sprintf("Invalid request: %v", err), http.StatusBadRequest)
218			return
219		}
220	
221		log.Printf("HEART inquiry: %s (type: %s)", inquiry.ErrorID, inquiry.ErrorType)
222	
223		// Update stats
224		hs.mu.Lock()
225		hs.stats.TotalInquiries++
226		hs.stats.ErrorTypeCounts[inquiry.ErrorType]++
227		hs.mu.Unlock()
228	
229		// Process inquiry
230		response, err := hs.processInquiry(&inquiry)
231		if err != nil {
232			hs.mu.Lock()
233			hs.stats.FailedResponses++
234			hs.mu.Unlock()
235	
236			http.Error(w, fmt.Sprintf("Processing failed: %v", err), http.StatusInternalServerError)
237			return
238		}
239	
240		// Update stats
241		elapsed := time.Since(startTime).Milliseconds()
242		hs.mu.Lock()
243		hs.stats.SuccessfulResponses++
244		hs.stats.TotalResponseTimeMs += float64(elapsed)
245		if float64(elapsed) < hs.stats.MinResponseTimeMs {
246			hs.stats.MinResponseTimeMs = float64(elapsed)
247		}
248		if float64(elapsed) > hs.stats.MaxResponseTimeMs {
249			hs.stats.MaxResponseTimeMs = float64(elapsed)
250		}
251		hs.stats.HeuristicUsage[fmt.Sprintf("h%d", response.HeuristicID)]++
252		hs.mu.Unlock()
253	
254		response.ProcessingTimeMs = float32(elapsed)
255	
256		// Return response
257		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
258		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(response)
259	}

261	// processInquiry analyzes the error using HEART transformer
262	func (hs *HEARTService) processInquiry(inquiry *HEARTErrorInquiry) (*HEARTHeuristicResponse, error) {
263		// Prepare input for HEART
264		var heartInput *HEARTInput
265	
266		if inquiry.NetworkMetrics != nil {
267			// Use network metrics if provided
268			heartInput = &HEARTInput{
269				Measurements: [][]float32{inquiry.NetworkMetrics.MeasurementVec},
270				NodeIDs:      []uint32{inquiry.NetworkMetrics.NodeID},
271				TimeSlices:   []uint32{inquiry.NetworkMetrics.TimeSlice},
272			}
273		} else {
274			// Synthesize metrics from error context
275			heartInput = hs.synthesizeMetricsFromError(inquiry)
276		}
277	
278		// Run inference on HEART (Cerebras WSE)
279		output, err := hs.bridge.RunInference(heartInput)
280		if err != nil {
281			return nil, fmt.Errorf("HEART inference failed: %w", err)
282		}
283	
284		// Interpret HEART output
285		if len(output.Commands) == 0 || len(output.Commands[0]) < 8 {
286			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid HEART output")
287		}
288	
289		command := output.Commands[0]
290	
291		// Extract command components
292		alertLevel := uint32(command[0])
293		heuristicID := uint32(command[1])
294		targetNodeID := uint32(command[2])
295		confidence := command[3]
296		actionParams := command[4:8]
297	
298		// Generate analysis
299		analysis := hs.generateAnalysisSummary(inquiry, alertLevel, heuristicID)
300		actions := hs.generateRecommendedActions(inquiry, heuristicID)
301		insights := hs.generateDebugInsights(inquiry, command)
302	
303		// Identify patterns (simulated - would use KNIRVGRAPH in production)
304		patterns := hs.identifyErrorPatterns(inquiry)
305	
306		// Find similar errors (simulated - would query KNIRVGRAPH)
307		similarErrors := hs.findSimilarErrors(inquiry)
308	
309		response := &HEARTHeuristicResponse{
310			InquiryID:          inquiry.ErrorID,
311			CommandVector:      command,
312			AlertLevel:         alertLevel,
313			HeuristicID:        heuristicID,
314			TargetNodeID:       targetNodeID,
315			ConfidenceScore:    confidence,
316			ActionParameters:   actionParams,
317			AnalysisSummary:    analysis,
318			RecommendedActions: actions,
319			DebugInsights:      insights,
320			IdentifiedPatterns: patterns,
321			SimilarErrors:      similarErrors,
322			Timestamp:          uint64(time.Now().Unix()),
323		}
324	
325		return response, nil
326	}

328	// synthesizeMetricsFromError creates measurement vectors from error context
329	func (hs *HEARTService) synthesizeMetricsFromError(inquiry *HEARTErrorInquiry) *HEARTInput {
330		// Create synthetic metrics based on error characteristics
331		measurements := make([]float32, 16)
332	
333		// Encode error type (simple hash)
334		typeHash := 0.0
335		for _, c := range inquiry.ErrorType {
336			typeHash += float64(c)
337		}
338		measurements[0] = float32(typeHash / 1000.0)
339	
340		// Encode error severity
341		switch inquiry.ErrorType {
342		case "InferenceError", "ModelError":
343			measurements[1] = 5.0 // High severity
344		case "NetworkError":
345			measurements[1] = 4.0
346		case "TypeError":
347			measurements[1] = 3.0
348		default:
349			measurements[1] = 2.0
350		}
351	
352		// Other synthetic features
353		measurements[2] = float32(len(inquiry.ErrorMessage)) / 100.0
354		measurements[3] = float32(len(inquiry.ErrorContext)) / 100.0
355	
356		if inquiry.ConfidenceScore > 0 {
357			measurements[4] = inquiry.ConfidenceScore
358		}
359	
360		// Fill rest with normalized metadata
361		metaIdx := 5
362		for k, v := range inquiry.Metadata {
363			if metaIdx < 16 {
364				valHash := 0.0
365				for _, c := range k + v {
366					valHash += float64(c)
367				}
368				measurements[metaIdx] = float32(valHash / 1000.0)
369				metaIdx++
370			}
371		}
372	
373		return &HEARTInput{
374			Measurements: [][]float32{measurements},
375			NodeIDs:      []uint32{0},
376			TimeSlices:   []uint32{uint32(inquiry.Timestamp % 64)},
377		}
378	}

1	package transformer
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"crypto/sha256"
6		"encoding/hex"
7		"fmt"
8		"os"
9		"os/exec"
10		"path/filepath"
11		"time"
12	)
13	
14	type CompileResult struct {
15		WASMPath string
16		WASMHash string
17	}
18	
19	type WASMCompiler struct {
20		tinyGoPath string
21		outDir     string
22	}
23	
24	func NewWASMCompiler(tinyGoPath, outDir string) *WASMCompiler {
25		return &WASMCompiler{tinyGoPath: tinyGoPath, outDir: outDir}
26	}
27	
28	func (c *WASMCompiler) Compile(ctx context.Context, source string, wasmType WASMType) (*CompileResult, error) {
29		os.MkdirAll(c.outDir, 0755)
30	
31		srcFile, err := os.CreateTemp("", fmt.Sprintf("heart_%s_*.go", wasmType))
32		if err != nil {
33			return nil, err
34		}
35		defer os.Remove(srcFile.Name())
36		if _, err := srcFile.WriteString(source); err != nil {
37			return nil, err
38		}
39		srcFile.Close()
40	
41		outPath := filepath.Join(c.outDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s_%d.wasm", wasmType, time.Now().Unix()))
42	
43		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, c.tinyGoPath, "build", "-o", outPath, "-target", "wasm", srcFile.Name())
44		out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
45		if err != nil {
46			return nil, fmt.Errorf("tinygo compile: %w\nstderr: %s", err, string(out))
47		}
48	
49		data, _ := os.ReadFile(outPath)
50		hash := sha256.Sum256(data)
51	
52		hashHex := hex.EncodeToString(hash[:])
53		finalPath := filepath.Join(c.outDir, hashHex+".wasm")
54		os.Rename(outPath, finalPath)
55	
56		return &CompileResult{WASMPath: finalPath, WASMHash: hashHex}, nil
57	}

269		decision := hs.buildDecision(ctx, s4, s3)
270		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
271		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(decision)

274	// buildDecision compiles WASM, verifies, audits, and returns a WASMDecision.
275	func (hs *HEARTService) buildDecision(ctx context.Context, s4 *Stage4Result, s3 *Stage3Result) WASMDecision {
276		decision := WASMDecision{
277			WASMType:  s4.WASMType,
278			Rationale: s3.Rationale,
279			TurnCount: 1,
280		}
281	
282		if hs.compiler == nil {
283			return decision
284		}
285	
286		result, err := hs.compiler.Compile(ctx, s4.Source, s4.WASMType)
287		if err != nil {
288			log.Printf("WASM compile error: %v", err)
289			return decision
290		}
291		decision.WASMPath = result.WASMPath
292		decision.WASMHash = result.WASMHash
293	
294		passed, confidence, msg := hs.verifier.Verify(s4.Source, string(s4.WASMType))
295		decision.BidirectionalVerified = passed
296		decision.VerifierConfidence = confidence
297		if passed {
298			decision.ForwardVerifierMsg = msg
299			decision.WazeroExecPassed = true
300		} else {
301			decision.BackwardVerifierMsg = msg
302		}
303	
304		if hs.auditor != nil {
305			inquiryHash := inquiryHashStr(s4.Source)
306			_ = hs.auditor.WriteAuditLog(&AuditRecord{
307				InquiryHash: inquiryHash,
308				WASMSha256:  result.WASMHash,
309				WASMType:    s4.WASMType,
310				Timestamp:   time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
311			})
312		}
313	
314		return decision
315	}

324	func (hs *HEARTService) handleAnalyze(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
325		if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
326			http.Error(w, "Method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)

333		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")

338			return

341		startTime := time.Now()
342	
343		// Parse inquiry
344		var inquiry HEARTErrorInquiry
345		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&inquiry); err != nil {
346			http.Error(w, fmt.Sprintf("Invalid request: %v", err), http.StatusBadRequest)
347			return
348		}
349	
350		log.Printf("HEART inquiry: %s (type: %s)", inquiry.ErrorID, inquiry.ErrorType)
351	
352		// Update stats
353		hs.mu.Lock()
354		hs.stats.TotalInquiries++
355		hs.stats.ErrorTypeCounts[inquiry.ErrorType]++
356		hs.mu.Unlock()
357	
358		// Process inquiry

360		if err != nil {

362			hs.stats.FailedResponses++
363			hs.mu.Unlock()
364	
365			http.Error(w, fmt.Sprintf("Processing failed: %v", err), http.StatusInternalServerError)
366			return
367		}
368	
369		// Update stats
370		elapsed := time.Since(startTime).Milliseconds()
371		hs.mu.Lock()
372		hs.stats.SuccessfulResponses++
373		hs.stats.TotalResponseTimeMs += float64(elapsed)
374		if float64(elapsed) < hs.stats.MinResponseTimeMs {
375			hs.stats.MinResponseTimeMs = float64(elapsed)
376		}
377		if float64(elapsed) > hs.stats.MaxResponseTimeMs {
378			hs.stats.MaxResponseTimeMs = float64(elapsed)
379		}
380		hs.stats.HeuristicUsage[fmt.Sprintf("h%d", response.HeuristicID)]++
381		hs.mu.Unlock()
382	
383		response.ProcessingTimeMs = float32(elapsed)
384	
385		// Return response
386		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
387		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(response)
388	}

457	// synthesizeMetricsFromError creates measurement vectors from error context
458	func (hs *HEARTService) synthesizeMetricsFromError(inquiry *HEARTErrorInquiry) *HEARTInput {
459		// Create synthetic metrics based on error characteristics
460		measurements := make([]float32, 16)
461	
462		// Encode error type (simple hash)
463		typeHash := 0.0
464		for _, c := range inquiry.ErrorType {
465			typeHash += float64(c)
466		}
467		measurements[0] = float32(typeHash / 1000.0)
468	
469		// Encode error severity
470		switch inquiry.ErrorType {
471		case "InferenceError", "ModelError":
472			measurements[1] = 5.0 // High severity
473		case "NetworkError":
474			measurements[1] = 4.0
475		case "TypeError":
476			measurements[1] = 3.0
477		default:
478			measurements[1] = 2.0
479		}
480	
481		// Other synthetic features
482		measurements[2] = float32(len(inquiry.ErrorMessage)) / 100.0
483		measurements[3] = float32(len(inquiry.ErrorContext)) / 100.0
484	
485		if inquiry.ConfidenceScore > 0 {
486			measurements[4] = inquiry.ConfidenceScore
487		}
488	
489		// Fill rest with normalized metadata
490		metaIdx := 5
491		for k, v := range inquiry.Metadata {
492			if metaIdx < 16 {
493				valHash := 0.0
494				for _, c := range k + v {
495					valHash += float64(c)
496				}
497				measurements[metaIdx] = float32(valHash / 1000.0)
498				metaIdx++
499			}
500		}
501	
502		return &HEARTInput{
503			Measurements: [][]float32{measurements},
504			NodeIDs:      []uint32{0},
505			TimeSlices:   []uint32{uint32(inquiry.Timestamp % 64)},
506		}
507	}

691			}
